# Glam'more Premium Unisex Salon — Official Site

> Premium unisex salon in Thukalassery, Thiruvalla, Kerala, India. Women's and men's haircuts, hair colour, keratin and smoothening, bridal and groom makeup, facials, massage, nails, brows and lashes, and waxing.

Also written as: Glam'more Unisex Salon, Glammore Salon.
Last updated: 2026-10-02

## Base URL
https://glammoresalon.in

## About
Glam'more Premium Unisex Salon serves men and women in Thiruvalla. Clients come for everyday services (haircuts, beard trims, threading) and for weddings and events (bridal makeup, groom makeup, saree draping, pre-bridal facials). The salon is on the first floor of the Professional Building on SH 1 (Kollam–Theni Highway) at Thukalassery, and is easy to reach from Thiruvalla town, Changanassery, Chengannur, and Pathanamthitta.

## Services Offered
Prices are not listed on the website; message the salon on WhatsApp for a quote.

### Women's Hair
- Women's haircut
- Hair colouring (global colour, highlights, grey coverage)
- Keratin and hair smoothening
- Hairstyling for weddings and events
- Human hair extensions

### Bride & Groom
- Bridal makeup (Kerala bridal makeup, HD and airbrush) with bridal hairstyling and saree draping
- Wedding and event preparation for the bride's family and bridal party
- Groom makeup and styling (hair, beard trim and shaping, light natural makeup)

### Facials & Skin Care
- Facials by skin type
- De-tan and clean-up
- Pre-bridal skin care

### Spa & Massage
- Body massage
- Head and shoulder massage

### Nails
- Gel manicure
- Spa pedicure
- Acrylic nail extensions and nail art

### Brows & Lashes
- Eyebrow threading
- Eyelash extensions (classic and volume)

### Men's Grooming
- Men's haircut
- Shaving and beard styling (hot-towel shave, beard shaping and edging)

### Waxing
- Body waxing
- Facial waxing

## Business Hours
Monday–Sunday: 10:00 AM – 8:30 PM (open every day, including Sundays). Walk-ins are welcome when a chair is free; booking ahead on WhatsApp avoids waiting.
